_comment: Retrieval regression-gate baseline. eval_retrieval.py --gate reads the thresholds here; falling below the floor is treated as a regression (CI fail). After the KB grew to 1000+ documents, switch to 'anchor metrics' for deterministic gating: anchor_* = whether the golden set's relevant_sources (the must-hit representative documents) are still retrieved, which is robust to re-chunking and independent of corpus size. The LLM judge's context_precision/hit are quality measures (--judge) and do not enter the CI gate (to save API). The thresholds below are conservative floor placeholders and must be calibrated by backfilling the first `--variant ensemble` measured values after the expanded KB is ingested (recommended: set the floor ~0.1 below the measured value).
